英文(全文)
In recent years, beekeeping has spread from the countryside to the rooftops of large cities. Many people assume that urban areas are too polluted for bees to survive. ( ① ), city bees often produce more honey than those kept on farms. This is largely because parks and gardens offer a wide variety of flowers, whereas modern farms tend to grow a single crop over vast areas.
